body: FANTAS1 is an RPG modpack that turns Minecraft into an epic adventure. Explore a world of new creatures, dungeons, structures and challenges. Get powerful weapons and armor, use backpacks to carry more resources, and fight dangerous enemies as you discover hidden treasures. FANTAS1 features classic RPG inspired progression, giving you hours of exploration, combat and adventure. ⚔️🎒🏰👹✨
